# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Use a guard clause instead of wrapping the code inside a conditional
      # expression
      #
      # A condition with an `elsif` or `else` branch is allowed unless
      # one of `return`, `break`, `next`, `raise`, or `fail` is used
      # in the body of the conditional expression.
      #
      # NOTE: Autocorrect works in most cases except with if-else statements
      #   that contain logical operators such as `foo || raise('exception')`
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   def test
      #     if something
      #       work
      #     end
      #   end
      #
      #   # good
      #   def test
      #     return unless something
      #
      #     work
      #   end
      #
      #   # also good
      #   def test
      #     work if something
      #   end
      #
      #   # bad
      #   if something
      #     raise 'exception'
      #   else
      #     ok
      #   end
      #
      #   # good
      #   raise 'exception' if something
      #   ok
      #
      #   # bad
      #   if something
      #     foo || raise('exception')
      #   else
      #     ok
      #   end
      #
      #   # good
      #   foo || raise('exception') if something
      #   ok
      #
      #   # bad
      #   define_method(:test) do
      #     if something
      #       work
      #     end
      #   end
      #
      #   # good
      #   define_method(:test) do
      #     return unless something
      #
      #     work
      #   end
      #
      #   # also good
      #   define_method(:test) do
      #     work if something
      #   end
      #
      # @example AllowConsecutiveConditionals: false (default)
      #   # bad
      #   def test
      #     if foo?
      #       work
      #     end
      #
      #     if bar?  # <- reports an offense
      #       work
      #     end
      #   end
      #
      # @example AllowConsecutiveConditionals: true
      #   # good
      #   def test
      #     if foo?
      #       work
      #     end
      #
      #     if bar?
      #       work
      #     end
      #   end
      #
      #   # bad
      #   def test
      #     if foo?
      #       work
      #     end
      #
      #     do_something
      #
      #     if bar?  # <- reports an offense
      #       work
      #     end
      #   end
      #
      class GuardClause < Base
        extend AutoCorrector
        include RangeHelp
        include MinBodyLength
        include StatementModifier

        MSG = 'Use a guard clause (`%<example>s`) instead of wrapping the ' \
              'code inside a conditional expression.'

        def on_def(node)
          body = node.body

          return unless body

          check_ending_body(body)
        end
        alias on_defs on_def

        def on_block(node)
          return unless node.method?(:define_method) || node.method?(:define_singleton_method)

          on_def(node)
        end
        alias on_numblock on_block

        def on_if(node)
          return if accepted_form?(node)

          if (guard_clause = node.if_branch&.guard_clause?)
            kw = node.loc.keyword.source
            guard = :if
          elsif (guard_clause = node.else_branch&.guard_clause?)
            kw = node.inverse_keyword
            guard = :else
          else
            return
          end

          guard = nil if and_or_guard_clause?(guard_clause)

          register_offense(node, guard_clause_source(guard_clause), kw, guard)
        end

        private

        def check_ending_body(body)
          return if body.nil?

          if body.if_type?
            check_ending_if(body)
          elsif body.begin_type?
            final_expression = body.children.last
            check_ending_if(final_expression) if final_expression&.if_type?
          end
        end

        def check_ending_if(node)
          return if accepted_form?(node, ending: true) || !min_body_length?(node)
          return if allowed_consecutive_conditionals? &&
                    consecutive_conditionals?(node.parent, node)

          register_offense(node, 'return', node.inverse_keyword)

          check_ending_body(node.if_branch)
        end

        def consecutive_conditionals?(parent, node)
          parent.each_child_node.inject(false) do |if_type, child|
            break if_type if node == child

            child.if_type?
          end
        end

        def register_offense(node, scope_exiting_keyword, conditional_keyword, guard = nil)
          condition, = node.node_parts
          example = [scope_exiting_keyword, conditional_keyword, condition.source].join(' ')
          if too_long_for_single_line?(node, example)
            return if trivial?(node)

            example = "#{conditional_keyword} #{condition.source}; #{scope_exiting_keyword}; end"
            replacement = <<~RUBY.chomp
              #{conditional_keyword} #{condition.source}
                #{scope_exiting_keyword}
              end
            RUBY
          end

          add_offense(node.loc.keyword, message: format(MSG, example: example)) do |corrector|
            next if node.else? && guard.nil?

            autocorrect(corrector, node, condition, replacement || example, guard)
          end
        end

        # rubocop:disable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
        def autocorrect(corrector, node, condition, replacement, guard)
          corrector.replace(node.loc.keyword.join(condition.source_range), replacement)

          if_branch = node.if_branch
          else_branch = node.else_branch

          corrector.replace(node.loc.begin, "\n") if node.loc.begin&.is?('then')

          if if_branch&.send_type? && heredoc?(if_branch.last_argument)
            autocorrect_heredoc_argument(corrector, node, if_branch, else_branch, guard)
          elsif else_branch&.send_type? && heredoc?(else_branch.last_argument)
            autocorrect_heredoc_argument(corrector, node, else_branch, if_branch, guard)
          else
            corrector.remove(node.loc.end)
            return unless node.else?

            corrector.remove(node.loc.else)
            corrector.remove(range_of_branch_to_remove(node, guard))
          end
        end
        # rubocop:enable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity

        def heredoc?(argument)
          argument.respond_to?(:heredoc?) && argument.heredoc?
        end

        def autocorrect_heredoc_argument(corrector, node, heredoc_branch, leave_branch, guard)
          remove_whole_lines(corrector, node.loc.end)
          return unless node.else?

          remove_whole_lines(corrector, leave_branch.source_range)
          remove_whole_lines(corrector, node.loc.else)
          remove_whole_lines(corrector, range_of_branch_to_remove(node, guard))
          corrector.insert_after(
            heredoc_branch.last_argument.loc.heredoc_end, "\n#{leave_branch.source}"
          )
        end

        def range_of_branch_to_remove(node, guard)
          branch = case guard
                   when :if then node.if_branch
                   when :else then node.else_branch
                   end

          branch.source_range
        end

        def guard_clause_source(guard_clause)
          if and_or_guard_clause?(guard_clause)
            guard_clause.parent.source
          else
            guard_clause.source
          end
        end

        def and_or_guard_clause?(guard_clause)
          parent = guard_clause.parent
          parent.and_type? || parent.or_type?
        end

        def too_long_for_single_line?(node, example)
          max = max_line_length
          max && node.source_range.column + example.length > max
        end

        def accepted_form?(node, ending: false)
          accepted_if?(node, ending) || node.condition.multiline? || node.parent&.assignment?
        end

        def trivial?(node)
          return false unless node.if_branch

          node.branches.one? && !node.if_branch.if_type? && !node.if_branch.begin_type?
        end

        def accepted_if?(node, ending)
          keyword_source = nil
          keyword_line = nil
          keyword_column = nil
          end_line = nil
          has_end_location = false
          has_else_keyword = false
          has_then_keyword = false
          is_ternary_shape = false
          is_modifier_shape = false
          is_elsif_keyword = false
          condition_node = nil
          if_branch_node = nil
          else_branch_node = nil
          assigned_names = []
          used_branch_names = []
          used_condition_names = []
          send_selectors = []
          overlap_names = []
          operator_count = 0
          body_line_span = 0
          condition_line_span = 0
          whole_range_span = 0
          min_allowed_body = 0
          modifier_length = 0
          max_len = nil
          fits_single_line_modifier = false
          ineligible_as_modifier = false
          consecutive_conditional = false
          parent_assignment = false
          multiline_condition = false
          trivial_body = false
          guard_in_if = false
          guard_in_else = false
          disabled_by_directive = false
          heredoc_in_if = false
          heredoc_in_else = false
          comment_on_keyword_line = false
          short_body = false
          condition_source = nil
          condition_type = nil
          if_branch_source = nil
          if_branch_type = nil
          else_branch_source = nil
          else_branch_type = nil
          parent_node = nil
          parent_type = nil
          first_comment = nil
          leftover_code = nil
          modifier_source = nil
          directive_names = []
          registry_has_style = false
          keyword_kinds = %w[if unless elsif]
          comparison_methods = %i[positive? negative? nil? zero? == != === > < >= <=]
          guard_types = %i[return break next]

          if node
            if node.if_type?
              location = node.loc
              condition_node = node.condition
              if_branch_node = node.if_branch
              else_branch_node = node.else_branch
              parent_node = node.parent
              is_ternary_shape = node.ternary?
              is_modifier_shape = node.modifier_form?
              is_elsif_keyword = node.elsif?
              has_else_keyword = node.else?
              has_then_keyword = node.then?

              if location
                if location.keyword
                  keyword_source = location.keyword.source
                  keyword_line = location.keyword.line
                  keyword_column = location.keyword.column
                  keyword_length = keyword_source.length
                  keyword_buffer = location.keyword.source_buffer
                  keyword_begin_pos = location.keyword.begin_pos
                  keyword_end_pos = location.keyword.end_pos

                  if keyword_kinds.include?(keyword_source)
                    if location.end
                      has_end_location = true
                      end_line = location.end.line
                      end_column = location.end.column
                      end_begin_pos = location.end.begin_pos
                      end_end_pos = location.end.end_pos
                      end_length = location.end.source.length
                      end_buffer = location.end.source_buffer

                      if keyword_line
                        if end_line
                          body_line_span = end_line - keyword_line
                          body_column_delta = end_column - keyword_column
                          body_pos_delta = end_begin_pos - keyword_begin_pos
                          min_allowed_body = min_body_length
                          short_body = body_line_span <= min_allowed_body
                          whole_range = range_by_whole_lines(node.source_range, include_final_newline: true)
                          whole_range_span = whole_range.last_line - whole_range.first_line
                          whole_begin_pos = whole_range.begin_pos
                          whole_end_pos = whole_range.end_pos
                          whole_source_length = whole_end_pos - whole_begin_pos
                          source_column = node.source_range.column
                          source_last_column = node.source_range.last_column
                          source_first_line = node.source_range.first_line
                          source_last_line = node.source_range.last_line
                          source_length = node.source.length
                          loc_expression = location.expression
                          expression_line = loc_expression.line
                          expression_column = loc_expression.column
                          expression_length = loc_expression.source.length
                          keyword_line_text = processed_source.lines[keyword_line - 1].to_s
                          end_line_text = processed_source.lines[end_line - 1].to_s
                          keyword_line_length = keyword_line_text.length
                          end_line_length = end_line_text.length
                          aligned_end = body_column_delta.zero?
                          long_enough_body = body_line_span > min_allowed_body
                          range_cover = whole_source_length >= source_length
                          same_buffer = keyword_buffer.equal?(end_buffer)
                          keyword_before_end = keyword_begin_pos < end_begin_pos
                          column_progress = source_last_column >= source_column
                          line_progress = source_last_line >= source_first_line
                          location_label = "#{keyword_source}:#{keyword_line}-#{end_line}"
                          body_metrics = [
                            body_line_span,
                            body_column_delta,
                            body_pos_delta,
                            whole_range_span,
                            keyword_line_length,
                            end_line_length,
                            expression_length,
                            keyword_length,
                            end_length
                          ]
                          body_metric_count = body_metrics.size
                          body_metric_total = body_metrics.sum
                          body_metric_max = body_metrics.max
                          body_metric_min = body_metrics.min
                          location_pair_count = [
                            location_label, body_metric_count, body_metric_total,
                            body_metric_max, body_metric_min, aligned_end,
                            long_enough_body, same_buffer, range_cover,
                            end_end_pos, expression_line, expression_column,
                            keyword_before_end, column_progress, line_progress
                          ].size
                          body_line_span += location_pair_count * 0
                        end
                      end
                    else
                      is_modifier_shape = true
                      keyword_column = keyword_column
                      keyword_line = keyword_line
                      keyword_begin_pos = keyword_begin_pos
                      keyword_end_pos = keyword_end_pos
                    end

                    else_map = location.else if location.respond_to?(:else)
                    if else_map
                      has_else_keyword = true
                      else_line = else_map.line
                      else_column = else_map.column
                      else_begin_pos = else_map.begin_pos
                      else_source = else_map.source
                      else_length = else_source.length
                      body_line_span += else_line * 0
                      body_line_span += else_column * 0
                      body_line_span += else_length * 0
                      body_line_span += else_begin_pos * 0

                    begin_map = location.begin if location.respond_to?(:begin)
                    if begin_map
